inserts.what: CCTV monitor playback frame (215)
inserts.design: A rounded dark-grey monitor bezel with a green power LED. Inside: scanlines, 'CAM 01' plus a red dot and 'REC' at top left, an English date/time stamp at top right, '> x1' with a progress bar at the bottom. The shop sign in the frame must become an English generic name such as 'NOODLES & BUNS' or be left blank. New: the existing inserts have no CCTV-monitor frame.

inserts.what: Missing-person poster, tilted, taped and numbered (216)
inserts.design: An off-white sheet with tape at the corners. Red headline 'MISSING PERSON' over 'MISSING' letter-spaced. A framed flat portrait, a red circle badge with a number (7), and name, age, date, time and location lines in English. Pull-tabs at the bottom. The existing `missing_poster` should be checked. New parts: the numbered badge, the tilt and the blurred-wall variant.

inserts.what: Cold-room thermometer alarm panel (217)
inserts.design: A white panel with frost on top, on corrugated frosted metal walls. A black LCD shows red glowing segment digits '-16.1' and '°C' with a red 'ALARM' dot. Label 'COLD ROOM' (English only). Three round buttons. Not in the catalog yet.

inserts.what: Hand POV: spoon in a bowl of soup with meatballs (218)
inserts.design: Top-down table, a pale plate of broth with meatballs and herb flecks, a glass of water, a tiny saucer. One hand in a green sleeve holds the spoon from the top right. Not in the catalog yet.

inserts.what: Hands tearing a ruled notebook page with a rule written on it (219)
inserts.design: Two hands in navy sleeves rip a lined notebook sheet with a jagged tear. Red headline 'RULE #1', a big bold line such as 'DON'T EAT THE SPECIAL FILLING' and a red underline, then a small line 'at Uncle's shop'. A red tape tab at the top. The existing `rule_paper` should be checked. New: the torn-in-two state with hands.

inserts.what: Title card on a cracked wall with an over-the-shoulder listener (220)
inserts.design: Grungy grey concrete with a vertical crack and a dark stain. A big dark headline with a red glow ('THE NEIGHBOUR' in English only) and letter-spaced subtitle text. In the foreground, the back of a man's head and his hand cupped to the wall. Close to the existing `black_frame_text`, but this is a wall-texture title-card variant.

inserts.what: Three paper bun bags with a red stamp on a desk, plus a stat chip (221)
inserts.design: Three white paper takeaway bags with a red circle stamp; the stamp must use an English or blank wordmark such as 'BUNS'. A brown desk edge and a blurred office. Top-left counter chip: '3 bags · FREE BUNS ON THE DESK'. New.

inserts.what: Shop banner sign with a marigold garland (222)
inserts.design: A red signboard with a gold double border and yellow-orange flower garland beads along the top. Big cream headline plus a subline, all in English generic text such as 'AUNTIE'S STEAMED BUNS' and 'FRESH PORK DAILY'. A red 'NEW!' tag at the top right and a red wooden slat wall below. New.

inserts.what: Evidence layout: silver jewellery with numbered markers (223)
inserts.design: Dark slate background with these items: a pendant, a hair clip, a bangle, a ring, a wristwatch, a beaded bracelet and a necklace with a diamond pendant. Each has a yellow evidence tag numbered 1-7. Top-left info card: 'VICTIMS' pill, 'UNDER 25', 'SILVER JEWELLERY' with a yellow highlight. New. The evidence markers can be reused on their own.

inserts.what: Hands breaking a steamed bun open to show the filling (224)
inserts.design: Two hands tear a white bun in half to show pink meat filling with peppercorns. Dark blurred backdrop. New, with a food-close-up feel.

inserts.what: Items-on-hand checklist card plus a flashlight and a broken mop handle (226)
inserts.design: Top-down wood plank floor with a black flashlight and a hand gripping a splintered wooden pole with a red tip. A dashed outline of a gun crossed out in red. The card reads 'ON HAND', 'X GUN', '! FLASHLIGHT x1', 'MOP HANDLE x1' (highlighted), 'NO GUN · A TORCH · A BROKEN MOP HANDLE'. New.

inserts.what: Gun falling into a floor drain or grinder hole (227)
inserts.design: Top-down view of a white panelled floor with a round dark drain, fan blades inside and a spark burst. A pink smear and a red recording dot at the top right. New, though it could be generalised as a 'thing falling into a drain' shot.

inserts.what: Hospital hand-holding close-up (229)
inserts.design: A patient's brown arm lying on a white blanket with an IV cannula, tape and a scar. A visitor's hand in a purple polka-dot sleeve reaches down to hold it. New.

inserts.what: Phone: outgoing or incoming call screen held in hand (230)
inserts.design: A dark phone with a status bar showing 08:12, a circle avatar with an initial, caller name text and 00:00, and a 3x2 grid of round buttons with captions in English: 'Mute', 'Keypad', 'Speaker', 'Add call', 'Video', 'Contacts'. A red end-call button. Thumb pressing. A hand-held POV with a blurred office behind. New: a call screen is not among the existing phone_chat, phone_lock and phone_bank.

inserts.what: Blue plastic drums on a flatbed cart, with a counter chip (232)
inserts.design: Three ribbed blue plastic drums with a dark drip stain, on a grey flatbed hand cart with big wheels. Chip: '! 0 drums · BLUE DRUMS'. Also usable as standalone props: two blue drums and a small bucket (235). New.

inserts.what: Cleaver plus sharpening steel close-up (236)
inserts.design: Two tattooed forearms honing a rectangular steel cleaver (with a hole, a riveted brown handle and a red edge) along a ridged honing rod. Spark burst. Dark green background. New. A cleaver held in hand also appears in 233.

inserts.what: Handing over a steamed bun (237)
inserts.design: A hand in a navy sleeve holds a white bun in the palm while a tattooed hand reaches in from the right. Blurred shop background. New.

inserts.what: Motorbike helmet and bags left in a freezer (225)
inserts.design: A green full-face helmet with a dark visor on a wire shelf, a canvas tote and a plum basket below, with frost. Hinting at a missing person's belongings. New.

inserts.what: Stat or info chip overlays (221, 223, 226, 232)
inserts.design: A small rounded beige card with a red or yellow left accent bar, an icon, a big red number plus a unit, and a small caps English caption. The format is a reusable template. Is it in overlays.json? It is not in inserts.

new_vs_existing:

Not seen in this batch: a GPS or map phone screen, a receipt, a blueprint, a cross-section diagram, a cork investigation board as a close-up (it is only blurred in 230 and 240), price tags, and a wristwatch close-up (it is only evidence item 5).

ENGLISH RULE
Every Thai string in these frames has to become generic English or be left out. That covers the shop names on signs, bags and stamps, the poster name and address, the call-button captions, the panel label and the rule text. The 'Sigma Lens' watermark, specific names (the shop owners, the victim's name and the street) and any national flag must not be reproduced.
